name: Vozvraschenie v «Sovjonok»
source:
Semyon, a year after his return to the real world (based on the bad ending of the corresponding girl), finds nothing in his ordinary life that could make him stop thinking about her.

"Who waits with prudence will be rewarded in dear time" - by the will of fate, the hero again finds himself in the same camp, in the same shift. Only this time, his beloved remembers him. And not just her...
translation:
谢苗回到现实世界一年后（基于相应女孩的糟糕结局），在他的日常生活中发现没有什么可以让他停止思考她。

“谨慎等待，必将得到宝贵的时间”——命运的安排，英雄再次发现自己处于同一个阵营，同一个转变。唯有这一次，他的爱人记住了他。而且不只是她…
